projects.name: Enterprise Digital Twin AI
projects.summary: Private MangoZest Enterprises work building a digital twin clone that answers questions like a specific person or business role, including tone, behaviour, communication style, and controlled company context.
details: Built for MangoZest Enterprises as private client/internal work.
Uses company context retrieval to answer questions from controlled internal knowledge.
Shapes responses around the expected tone, behaviour, and communication pattern of the twin.
Keeps authentication, access checks, and sensitive data boundaries on the backend.
The source code is private, so the portfolio explains the system rather than linking to a public repository.

projects.name: Lassa Fever Outbreak Prediction System
projects.summary: Surveillance and forecasting platform for Nigerian Lassa fever data with a FastAPI backend, Streamlit dashboard, CSV upload workflow, risk scoring, and forecast endpoints.
details: Uses a CSV-based data boundary for case and environmental data.
Provides endpoints for cases, summaries, uploads, forecasts, risk levels, and metrics.
Supports offline model training and dashboard exploration.

projects.name: Air Quality Respiratory Risk Prediction
projects.summary: ML pipeline and API for predicting respiratory disease risk from air quality, weather, seasonal, and lag features.
details: Compares Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost models.
Uses pollutant, AQI, weather, seasonal, and lag-based features.
Includes a local API and frontend integration for location-based predictions.

projects.name: Identity Verification Engine
projects.summary: Private MangoZest Enterprises identity verification engine using OCR to extract ID details, face extraction, liveness detection, face matching, and WebSocket status updates for the frontend.
details: Built for MangoZest Enterprises as private client/internal work.
Uses OCR to extract structured details from identity documents.
Extracts the face from the ID document and compares it with the user's live stream face.
Uses liveness detection to reduce spoofing risk during verification.
Transfers verification progress and messages to the frontend through WebSockets.
The source code is private, so the portfolio explains the system rather than linking to a public repository.

projects.name: ID Extract
projects.summary: Document extraction engine for ID cards and passports, focused on OCR reliability, MRZ recovery, model manifest checks, ONNX runtime work, and packaging validation.
details: Handles ID and passport OCR extraction.
Includes MRZ-first recovery and model manifest integrity checks.
Validates packaging and runtime behavior before release.
